# Fixtures

| Directory | Contents |
|---|---|
| `sample/` | a small project written for the tests |
| `tempest/` | *The Tempest* by William Shakespeare, set horizontally |
| `kanikosen/` | 『蟹工船』小林多喜二, set vertically |

`tempest/tempest.gm` and `kanikosen/kanikosen.gm` are generated by
`scripts/fixtures/fetch-public-domain.sh`, which downloads the texts,
checks their SHA-256, converts them with `golem-fixtures` (the converters in
`modules/golem-fixtures`, run through `cabal run`;
[docs/adr/0023](../../../../docs/adr/0023-fixture-converters-without-python.md)) and
formats them with `golem fmt`.
Do not edit them by hand. To make them again:

```sh
GOLEM=$(cabal list-bin golem) scripts/fixtures/fetch-public-domain.sh
```

## Sources

- *The Tempest*: Project Gutenberg eBook #23042, the Cambridge edition
  (1863) edited by W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright. The play is in the public
  domain. The converter drops the Project Gutenberg header and licence,
  the transcriber's note, the footnotes and the textual notes; the result
  carries no Project Gutenberg trademark. Verse is set with `@style verse`. The
  source marks verse only by its line breaks, so the converter guesses it
  and takes a few short prose speeches whose lines all start with capitals
  for verse (two in Act I, Scene I).
- 『蟹工船』: 青空文庫 図書カード No.1465（底本「蟹工船・党生活者」新潮文庫）。
  著作権の保護期間は満了している。入力者、校正者と底本の情報は、青空文庫の
  ファイルにあるとおり `kanikosen.gm` の末尾に残している。

## Fonts

Each book carries its fonts under `fonts/`, with their licences, so the
fixture builds as it is (`golem build` in its directory).

- `kanikosen/fonts/NotoSerifJP-Regular.otf`: Noto Serif CJK JP 2.003, the
  Japanese subset OTF from https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk (release
  `Serif2.003`, `12_NotoSerifJP.zip`), SHA-256
  `2c9a12dbd4f2408c4610c7ee84a108b62d7236c3775baed618c64d9cb44b2f04`.
  SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- `tempest/fonts/SourceSerifVariable-Roman.ttf`: Source Serif, the test
  font of golem-font (variable; Golem uses its default instance).
  SIL Open Font License 1.1.
